title: Existing Azure VM Serving Validation
verdict_rationale: The retrieval pipeline itself (H1 BM25, H3_RRF20 hybrid with pre-computed embeddings, RRF fusion, frozen-benchmark quality reproduction, memory, cold start, BM25 fallback) is validated on this exact VM. The BGE-M3 ENCODER is BLOCKED (not cached, torch/sentence-transformers absent, download forbidden), so end-to-end hybrid latency INCLUDING encoding is UNRESOLVED and the p95/p99 gates cannot be closed. Azure free credit is not a permanent Rs.0 recurring-cost guarantee and the balance is not verifiable, so the cost gate is UNRESOLVED. Full Qwen assistant is NOT feasible (no Qwen3-8B-Base inference serving implementation exists; only training code).

vm_manifest.python_system: 3.12.3 (numpy 2.5.3; no torch, no transformers, no sentence-transformers, no faiss)

existing_application.ollama: ollama serve running qwen2.5:7b-instruct (Q4_K_M, 4.7 GB, 7.6B params) -- DIFFERENT model from the project Qwen3-8B-Base+DAPT lineage
existing_application.process_manager: No Docker; orchestrator + ollama run as raw processes. No systemd user units.
existing_application.note: Existing application preserved; no restart/redeploy performed.

vm_manifest.memory_headroom_after_existing_app: 13.9 GiB available of 15.6 GiB (existing app + opencode + ollama ~2.1 GiB used)

azure_cost_verification.consumption_api: az consumption usage list returned 20 rows naming the VM/OS-disk/public-IP resources, but ALL cost/quantity/billing-period fields were null (free-credit subscription does not expose per-resource cost via this API).
azure_cost_verification.balance_access: az billing balance show requires --account-name/--profile-name that are not available; credit balance and expiration could NOT be read.
azure_cost_verification.subscription_id: present but REDACTED from all reports per policy.
azure_cost_verification.free_credit_caveat: Azure free credit is a finite, expiring balance. It is NOT a sustainable Rs.0 recurring-cost guarantee after expiry. The Standard_B4as_v2 VM, its OS disk, and public IP are billable resources that consume credit.

compatibility_findings.h1_bm25_production_default: CONFIRMED. configs/policy.toml [retrieval] mode = "bm25"; unchanged from Task 76.
compatibility_findings.h3_rrf20_opt_in: CONFIRMED. RetrievalMode.HYBRID_RRF20 is opt-in via policy; not the default.
compatibility_findings.dense_index_loadable: CONFIRMED. Task-74 sha-verified dense index (BGE-M3 rev 5617a9f, corpus_emb.f16.npy 320.8 MB, sha f54919e...) loads on this VM via numpy with NO content change. Dense search = numpy matmul; no torch needed for the index itself.
compatibility_findings.runtime_dependencies: BM25 + dense index + fusion need only numpy + stdlib (PRESENT). The BGE-M3 ENCODER needs torch + sentence-transformers (ABSENT in system python and fpvenv) and the bge-m3 model (NOT cached in ~/.cache/huggingface/hub). Installing torch/sentence-transformers and downloading bge-m3 are out of scope for this task.
compatibility_findings.provenance_and_fallback: CONFIRMED. RetrievalService preserves contract.validate_result provenance; fallback_to_bm25 is explicit, logged, and returns non-empty BM25 results (fallback probe PASS).
compatibility_findings.frozen_artifacts_unchanged: CONFIRMED. Frozen benchmark sha 06625f7... VERIFIED; dense index sha VERIFIED; corpus/manifest unchanged. No rebuild/modification performed.

encoder.reason: bge-m3 not cached; torch/sentence-transformers absent; model download + large dependency install out of scope.
encoder.requirement_for_separately_authorized_be: Install torch + sentence-transformers (CPU build) and download BAAI/bge-m3 (model rev 5617a9f, ~2.2 GB download, ~3.8 GB peak RAM), then run the bounded encoder smoke test in Task-78 experiments/task78/task78_validate_plan.md.

task78_gate_assessment.evidence: Azure free credit is finite/expiring; VM+disk+IP are billable; credit balance not verifiable via available APIs. Not a sustainable Rs.0 guarantee.
Retrieval-only H3 p95 = 1057 ms (encoder excluded). Encoder latency NOT measured (BLOCKED). Cannot close the gate without encoder measurement.
Retrieval-only H3 p99 = 1137 ms (encoder excluded). Encoder latency NOT measured (BLOCKED).
61.4 s measured without encoder load (Task-77 with encoder 71.9 s); both under 120 s.

Peak RSS 2124.8 MB (2.1 GB) measured. NOTE: the gate assumed a 12 GB host; this VM has 15.6 GiB total / 13.9 GiB available, so the original 12 GB hardware assumption does not apply. The measured 2.1 GB is far below any reasonable threshold on this host; recommend keeping the 8 GB RSS ceiling as a safety cap regardless of host size.

task78_gate_assessment.result_note: single-threaded by design; all measurements single-request.

task78_gate_assessment.evidence: unit@5 0.5385, src@5 0.9783 exact match to frozen aggregates.
fallback probe: mode= bm25, logged=true, results non-empty.
No Qwen3-8B-Base inference serving implementation exists (training code only). Ollama qwen2.5:7b is a different model. Not measured.

azure_suitability_retrieval_only.rationale: The retrieval pipeline runs correctly on this VM: frozen-benchmark quality reproduced exactly, retrieval-side H3 p95 = 1057 ms (well under the 2 s gate if encoder stays under ~940 ms, which BGE-M3 query encoding typically does), peak RSS 2.1 GB on a 15.6 GiB host, cold start 61 s, dense index 321 MB. BM25 fallback and provenance preserved. The VM is architecturally compatible (x86_64, AVX2 present).
conditions: Encoder latency must be measured in a separately authorized benchmark to close the p95/p99 gates.
Recurring cost is NOT Rs.0-sustainable once Azure free credit expires; a paid plan is required thereafter.
Single-concurrency only; the 2-physical-core CPU is the bottleneck (BM25 full scan p95 805 ms).

full_qwen_assistant_feasible.rationale: The project's generator is Qwen3-8B-Base with DAPT-01/SFT-01 adapters. There is NO inference/serving implementation for it in the repo (Task-78 audit finding re-verified: only training code dapt_trainer.py/sft_candidates.py and offline Colab inference task75_rag_infer.py, which produced frozen artifacts, not a serving path). Qwen3-8B-Base weights ARE cached in the HF hub but cannot be served without writing a new inference stack. Ollama is running qwen2.5:7b-instruct (a DIFFERENT, smaller model, not the project generator). The VM is a 2-physical-core CPU host with no GPU; 8B generation on CPU would be impractically slow (~1-3 tok/s) and would contend with the running application. No bounded generation test was run (out of scope; different model; no project serving impl).
full_qwen_assistant_feasible.not_claimed: Retrieval working does NOT imply Qwen generation is supported.
